sample_rule: prose/list/blockquote paragraphs after front matter (headings, tables, display math, rules excluded; 82 total); paragraphs 2, 5, 8, ... (27 paragraphs); 15 claims drawn from them

score_notes.A: Front matter complete (subtitle, paper_author 'Zep AI', paper_doi, two-level categories, use_math), no H1, $$ math only, real tables. Heading L221 '상위 20개 엣지·노드만 넣는 평가 프로토콜' frames the protocol as shared, but DMR used top 10 (L233).
score_notes.B: 입니다 register throughout; but repetitive sentences: L171 opens and repeats '주기적인 전체 갱신이 여전히 필요합니다' within one paragraph; L227 states the Zep-only latency three times ('Zep 쪽에만 더해진 네트워크 지연이 있습니다' ... '이 지연이 기준선 평가에는 없었다고 적습니다. 그래서 이 구간의 네트워크 지연은 Zep 쪽에만 더해졌습니다.'); L269 '가상의 예로 설명하면, 짧은 컨텍스트가 정확도를 높일 수 있는 이유는 앞서 든 이사 예시로 그려 볼 수 있습니다.' -> '짧은 컨텍스트가 왜 정확도를 높이는지 이사 예시로 짐작해 보겠습니다.'; L300 '앞서 든 이사 예시를 이 구분에 대어 보면' awkward; L62 '표에서 볼 수 있듯이' formulaic.
score_notes.C: L223 '절차는 두 실험에서 같습니다 ... 엣지(사실) 20개와 엔티티 노드(엔티티 요약) 20개' contradicts L233 'Zep은 ... 상위 10개씩 꺼냈습니다 ... LongMemEval 프로토콜은 이보다 많은' (the paper has the same inconsistency; the post states both without reconciling). Recap paragraphs L271 and L302 restate the preceding paragraph and read stitched.
score_notes.D: Bi-temporal model and invalidation get exactly the right help (L83 table, L141 rule, L144 worked example). Over-hedging pads easy parts: '가상' appears 11 times; '논문은 ... 분석/검증하지 않았습니다' at L269, L271, L300 (three times in one paragraph), L304.
score_notes.E: DMR, LongMemEval and type-breakdown tables copy cells verbatim (L235-244, L258-263, L281-294); invalidation and composition formulas placed where discussed. L162 vote table repeats L158 prose (decorative).
score_notes.F: No wrong table cells. Deductions: L30 TL;DR 'DMR에서는 gpt-4o-mini 기준 98.2%를 기록했지만, MemGPT와 전체 대화 기준선보다 근소하게 높은 수준' compares a gpt-4o-mini score with MemGPT, which only has a gpt-4-turbo result (93.4%), and the abstract headline is 94.8 vs 93.4 on gpt-4-turbo (-2). L267 '평균만 빨라진 것이 아니라' calls the latency column a mean; the paper never says mean or median (-0.5). L314 places the single-session-assistant drop and 'less capable models' understanding of temporal data' in one limitation bullet; the paper ties the latter to the 4o-mini knowledge-update result, not to single-session-assistant (-0.5). L125 labels '엔티티 쌍으로 범위를 제한하면 ... 잘못된 결합을 피할 수 있습니다' as '필자가 보기에', though the paper states it (Sec 2.2.2) (minor).

examples.claim: G=(N,E,phi), phi incidence function; three tiers; episodes store message/text/JSON non-lossy

examples.source: Sec 2.1: 'reference timestamp tref indicating when the message was sent ... (e.g., "next Thursday," "in two weeks," or "last summer")'

examples.claim: Predefined Cypher queries instead of LLM-generated queries, for consistent schema and fewer hallucinations
examples.source: Sec 2.2.1: 'using predefined Cypher queries. We chose this approach over LLM-generated database queries to ensure consistent schema formats and reduce the potential for hallucinations.'
